documents.title: Guiding Principles for AI Use in Teaching (GenAI Teaching Guidelines)
documents.summary: The page sets seven principles for faculty AI use and requires syllabus statements but sets no student rule. It leaves decisions to instructors and units, and discourages policing in favor of AI literacy.
documents.stance_why: Faculty must state "what is allowed or prohibited" in syllabi, and units are "encouraged to adapt these guidelines"; no default allow or ban is set, so decisions are delegated to instructors.
